basic_details.job_title: KVIC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Technical Expert, Retired/ Ex Bank officials Posts
basic_details.short_information: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) has notified vacancies for Technical Expert, Retired/ Ex Bank officials posts on a purely temporary contract basis up to 31 March 2027 in Nagpur. Eligible candidates holding a Bachelor's degree in any discipline can apply by sending the filled application form via email on or before 22 October 2026, starting from 7 October 2026. The engagement carries a lump sum consolidated amount of Rs. 40,000 per month. Selection is based on shortlisting based on qualifications and experience, followed by an interview. faq.question: Q1. Is the KVIC Technical Expert position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is on a purely temporary contract basis up to 31 March 2027, with potential for extension based on performance.

faq.question: Q2. Can retired officials apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, retired officials of KVIC, KVIB, DIC, MSME DI, NSIC, COIR Board (not below Assistant Director) as well as retired or ex-bank officials can apply if they meet the specific experience criteria.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 65 years for both Technical Expert and Retired/Ex Bank official posts.

faq.question: Q4. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their filled application forms via email to the official address [email protected] by 22 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.
